name: triad-codex-dispatch
description: Codex-led reviewer dispatch for Claude, Antigravity, Gemini, and convergent cross-family review.

interface.shortDescription: Cross-family dispatch and review workflows for Codex
interface.longDescription: Coordinate reviewer-only Claude, Google-family, and fresh Codex legs over one focused directory, with Codex retaining all implementation authority.
defaultPrompt: Use $triad-cross-family-review to review this change. Confirm the objective, approved data, and exact exclusions, then give Claude, Google, and fresh Codex the same complete focused directory. Codex reproduces findings, writes bounded fixes, and asks the owner before any design or scope change.
Use $triad-antigravity-dispatch for an owner-authorized reviewer-only Google-family leg through AGY 1.1.10 or newer with an explicit model and effort.
